metadata.title: Triefenhain
metadata.author: Leonhardit07 with Claude Sonnet 4.6
metadata.summary: A dark adventure set in and around the cursed village of Triefenhain. Ancient evils stir beneath the murky swamps, and the villagers live in fear of what lurks in the cave beyond the treeline.

npcs.name: Aldric Moorfen
npcs.backstory: Once a proud village elder, Aldric has watched Triefenhain slowly decay over the past decade. He suspects the cave to the north is the source of the creeping corruption but is too old and fearful to investigate himself.
npcs.motivation: Wants the adventurers to cleanse the Triefencave and restore peace to the village.

npcs.name: Mira Silt
npcs.backstory: A young herbalist who ventures near the swamp edges to gather rare mosses. She has seen shadowy figures wading through the swamp at night and keeps a secret journal of her observations.
npcs.motivation: Seeks proof that the Swampdwellers are intelligent beings, not monsters, hoping to negotiate peace.

npcs.name: Gorrak the Sunken
npcs.backstory: The elder of the Swampdwellers — a tribe of bog-adapted lizardfolk who have lived in the marshes for centuries. His people were driven from the cave by a dark presence and now haunt the swamp in desperation.
npcs.motivation: Reclaim the Triefencave, their ancestral home, from whatever evil has taken root inside.

npcs.name: Vesper Dankhollow
npcs.backstory: A disgraced wizard who fled to Triefenhain after a failed experiment. He secretly caused the corruption by attempting to tap into ley lines beneath the cave, and now runs the village inn trying to keep a low profile.
npcs.motivation: Prevent the adventurers from discovering his role in the disaster while appearing helpful.

chapters.title: Triefen
chapters.summary: The adventurers arrive at the decaying village of Triefenhain. The streets are muddy and half the buildings stand empty. Elder Aldric Moorfen greets them with desperate eyes and begs for help. Strange black moss creeps up the walls of buildings closest to the swamp. At the inn, Vesper Dankhollow is suspiciously eager to point the party toward the swamp and away from the cave. Investigation checks around the village reveal scorched arcane symbols beneath the inn's floorboards.
chapters.story: Triefenhain breathes like a tired old beast: shutters hang loose, and whispers cling to every alley. As the party walks the muddy lanes they begin to feel the village's exhaustion, and small acts of kindness from frightened villagers reveal the fragile hope still holding this place together. Rumors passed in hushed tones point toward the cave, and the inn's hearth seems to hold more secrets than warmth.

encounters.description: Meeting Elder Aldric — he offers 50 gold per adventurer to investigate the cave.
Searching the inn uncovers arcane symbols. DC 14 Arcana check reveals a ley-line siphoning ritual gone wrong.

chapters.title: Swampdwellers
chapters.summary: Venturing into the murky marshes near Triefenhain, the party encounters Gorrak's tribe of lizardfolk — the Swampdwellers. Initially hostile, they can be calmed through diplomacy or by showing Mira's journal. Gorrak reveals that a shadowy entity drove his people from the Triefencave three moons ago. He offers a guide and a Bogstone Amulet (advantage on saves vs. poison) in exchange for clearing the cave.
chapters.story: The marsh has its own language of chirps and creaks, and at first the Swampdwellers' silhouettes seem like tricks of steam. As conversations unfold, the tribe's sorrow and fierce pride become clear; they are not merely monsters but exiles guarding memories of the cave. Mira's journal acts as a bridge, and the party learns that old grievances and ancient pacts bind the swamp's fate to the village.

encounters.description: Ambush by 4 lizardfolk scouts (CR 1/2 each). Fighting back escalates tension; non-lethal resolution or diplomacy unlocks Gorrak's alliance.
Parley with Gorrak — DC 12 Persuasion or showing Mira's journal automatically succeeds.
The Sunken Idol holds a carving depicting the cave's layout, giving the party a rough map of Triefencave.

chapters.title: Triefencave
chapters.summary: The cave north of the village reeks of dark magic. Twisted fungi light the walls with sickly green glow. Three chambers await: the Entry Grotto filled with corrupted bats and slimes, the Ley-Node Chamber where Vesper's ritual circle still crackles with unstable energy, and the final Hollow — the lair of the Blightshade, a shadow elemental born from the botched ritual. Destroying the ritual circle weakens the Blightshade significantly. After the boss is defeated, the cave begins to stabilize and the black moss in the village starts to wither.
chapters.story: Cold air breathes out from the cave like regret, and every step deeper feels like turning a page in a forbidden book. The party finds signs of failed experiments and small tokens of those who tried before them, and the ritual's residue hums with desperate intent. In the final hollow the Blightshade waits, a wound made manifest, and the choices made in the Ley-Node Chamber will decide whether the darkness is cleansed or merely transformed.

encounters.description: Entry Grotto: 6 Corrupted Cave Bats (CR 1/4) and 2 Black Puddings (CR 4).

Ley-Node Chamber: DC 16 Arcana check to safely dismantle the ritual circle. Failure triggers an arcane burst (3d6 force damage, DEX save DC 14 for half). Success weakens the Blightshade (-30 HP and vulnerability to radiant damage).
The Blightshade (custom CR 7 shadow elemental). If the ritual circle was dismantled, it enters combat at 60 HP instead of 90 HP.
